sentences.en: I haven't felt like this since I was a teenager.
sentences.zh: 自从我十几岁以来就没再有过这种感觉。

sentences.en: The rock star is an idol of the teenagers.
sentences.zh: 这位摇滚明星是青少年们的偶像。

sentences.en: You could pass for a teenager if you wore a T-shirt.
sentences.zh: 如果你穿件T恤，你看上去就像个十几岁的少年。

senses.zh: 青少年，十几岁的孩子（13 到 19 岁之间的孩子）
